svg.title: Two plans from the same start: a straight line that falls short, and a curve planned back from a vision someone holds.
svg.desc: Two lines over the same time, both starting from today at the lower left. The vision sits at the upper right, highlighted: someone has to hold it. The first line, planned from the last step, climbs in a straight line and ends, on time, about halfway up. The gap between its end and the vision is shaded: still short. The second, planned from the vision, stays low at first, while new investments come online, crosses the straight line about halfway along, then climbs steeply toward the vision, if the investments land.
svg.text: slow while new investments come online,
